summary: Close-up of the host, who blinks, looks down, and answers a flat 'No'.
framing: Close-up, eye level, static: identical setup to S46 (host's head centre frame, glowing red-orange strip at the left edge, corner of a green-framed picture upper right).
props: green-framed picture, corner visible at upper right, static

beats.action: head 3/4 left, level; eyes wide open and round, pupils centred, staring left at the guest; brows neutral; mouth a small closed down-turned line; holds still
red-orange glow strip down the left edge of frame, steady for the whole shot
blink: eyes shut on 3594-3595, half open on 3596-3597
eyes open again but with the upper lids slanted down toward the outside (worried) and pupils dropped to the lower right of each eye: looking down and away from the guest; holds this
eyelids lower to half, pupils back to centre
eyes close fully; mouth opens showing the lower teeth as the word starts
chin lifts (head tips back slightly); eyes reopen half-lidded, pupils left on the guest; lips pushed forward in a small round 'o'
mouth closes to a small pursed pout; half-lidded, level stare at the guest; holds to the cut

notes: Camera static confirmed (left-edge strip moves < 0.5 px). Dialogue: L56 'No' is timed at 3617-3622 in script.json, but the mouth forms the word on 3613-3616 and is closed again from 3617, so the alignment looks about 4 frames late against the picture.
